'''Mirror Lake''' is situated in western [[Elwynn Forest]], near an [[Mirror Lake Orchard|orchard]]. It is rather small and features a beautiful waterfall. Although Mirror Lake would be an ideal spot for swimming or [[fishing]], the [[Defias]] bandits that infest the area make such sports hazardous.

After [[Azeroth]] had been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels, the flow of magic in [[Stormwind City]] and [[Elwynn Forest]] was somehow altered. Consequently, the [[mage]]s of the [[Wizard's Sanctum]] sent a mage [[adventurer]] to Mirror Lake, in order to test its water for magical properties before those who drank from it would be adversely affected.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|10|Mirror Lake (quest)|Mirror Lake|class=mage}}</ref>

A side entrance to the [[Stormwind Vault]] dungeon can be found at the base of [[Thunder Falls]] for Horde characters.
